column1: Every sound is synthesised at runtime — there are no audio files. wave: square | sawtooth | triangle | sine | noise. f0/f1 sweep in Hz over 'dur' ms. 'echo' is how much of the sound feeds the shared delay line. Everything runs through a bit-crusher, which is where the crunch comes from.
